2608.28306.title: VISTA: Verifier-Informed Student-to-Teacher Adaptation for On-Policy Self-Distillation
2608.28306.paper_summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a problem-only student on its own rollouts using dense token-level supervision from a privileged teacher that also sees a reference solution. However, standard OPSD treats the teacher distribution as a fixed target along the student's rollout and updates only the student %, although -- even though privileged conditioning does not guarantee that the teacher always provides the most appropriate target for problem-only reasoning. This one-way supervision can therefore misdirect the student when the teacher distribution is misaligned with valid student reasoning. We therefore introduce Verifier-Informed Student-to-Teacher Adaptation (VISTA), which preserves the standard OPSD student update while using outcome-verified rollouts to adapt the teacher toward the student distribution. Within each verified rollout, VISTA further restricts this adaptation to the top-$k$ positions with the largest teacher--student KL divergence. Notably, VISTA reuses the rollout and loss function from standard OPSD, introducing no additional sampling or separate reward objective. Across AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25 with Qwen3 models at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B, VISTA achieves the highest Avg@12 at every scale, improving over OPSD by $0.6$, $0.7$, and $2.1$ points, respectively. These results demonstrate the value of student supervision from outcome-verified rollouts and highlight student-to-teacher adaptation as a promising direction for OPSD.
2608.28306.paper_summary_zh: 在政策自蒸餾（OPSD）中，通過使用來自特權教師的密集標記級監督，改善了推理，該教師也能看到參考解決方案，並在其自身的回滾中訓練一個僅針對問題的學生。然而，標準的 OPSD 將教師分佈視為沿著學生回滾的固定目標，只更新學生的 %，儘管特權條件並不保證教師總是提供最合適的針對問題的推理目標。因此，這種單向監督可能會在教師分佈與有效學生推理不一致時誤導學生。因此，我們引入了驗證者知情的學生對教師適應（VISTA），它在使用結果驗證的回滾來調整教師朝向學生分佈的同時，保留了標準 OPSD 學生更新。在每個經過驗證的回滾中，VISTA 進一步將這種適應限制在具有最大教師-學生 KL 散度的前 $k$ 個位置。值得注意的是，VISTA 重用了標準 OPSD 的回滾和損失函數，沒有引入額外的抽樣或單獨的獎勵目標。在 AIME24、AIME25 和 HMMT25 中，使用 Qwen3 模型，參數分別為 1.7B、4B 和 8B，VISTA 在每個規模上都達到了最高的 Avg@12，分別比 OPSD 提高了 $0.6$、$0.7$ 和 $2.1$ 分。這些結果展示了來自結果驗證回滾的學生監督的價值，並突顯了學生對教師適應作為 OPSD 的一個有前景的方向。
